topic: Modes of Reproduction of Flowering Plants
key_concepts: Flowering plants reproduce sexually and asexually
Sexual reproduction in flowering plants starts in the flower and produces seeds
Pollination is the transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of the same or
Fertilization takes place in the ovary when the sperm cell unites with the egg cell
Asexual reproduction produces new plants without sex cells or seeds
Sexual reproduction involves both male and female parents
Asexual reproduction involves only one parent plant
Sexual reproduction occurs in bisexual and higher plants with fully developed reproductive
Asexual reproduction occurs in unisexual and lower plants without reproductive organs
Seeds are used to get new plants from a flower in sexual reproduction
Asexual reproduction does not need seeds
